newsitem.title: USA: Bell Atlantic results mixed out of region.
newsitem.headline: Bell Atlantic results mixed out of region.

text.p: Bell Atlantic Corp on Thursday said it had matched its aggressive expectations in out-of-region long distance services for business clients, but had fallen short on the consumer side.
"We had very aggressive goals. We are up to expectations with business...(but) we are below objective on the consumer side," general counsel James Young told a press briefing.
He gave no details. Bell Atlantic started providing long distance services on July 31 in Michigan, North Carolina and Texas, and has plans for further expansion.

It is not allowed to offer long distance calling in its own regions until it meets a regulatory checklist which shows its own local calling market is competitive. It expects to be able to meet that checklist in the first quarter of 1997. -- Nick Louth, New York Newsroom 212 859 1610
